reason: I might take the free audit if a 45-minute call really covers the exports, but I'm not signing up for another monthly reporting tool off the back of it. I've paid for one of those before and after the first month nobody opened it.
objection: It's another dashboard. The audit will look great once, then it turns into a report I don't read at month end, while I'm still raising invoices by hand.
would_change_my_mind: If the audit turned up real money I could bill, with the tickets behind it, and the monthly check dropped straight into my invoicing run without me logging into anything new, I'd pay.
